description: A helper class for handling nullability checks and exceptions in a code migration context related to nullable reference types in C#.

classes.name: NRT
classes.description: Static helper class providing methods to throw exceptions when null references are encountered, aiding in nullable reference type migration.

methods.name: ThrowOnNull
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException when a non-nullable expression is null. Used during code migration to nullable references.

methods.name: ThrowOnNull<TResult>
methods.description: Generic method that throws an InvalidOperationException indicating a null value where it should not be null, returning no value.

methods.name: ThrowOnNull<TResult, TType>
methods.description: Generic method that throws an InvalidOperationException indicating a null value of a specific type where it should not be null.
